title: Anthropic Employee Claims Proof of Riemann Hypothesis Using Claude
excerpt: An Anthropic employee states they worked alongside the Claude AI assistant to discover a mathematical proof for the Riemann Hypothesis.
body_html:
An employee at Anthropic has stated that they worked alongside the Claude artificial intelligence assistant to discover a mathematical proof for the Riemann Hypothesis, one of the most famous and long-standing problems in mathematics.

Levent Alpöge shared the claim regarding the collaboration with the AI model. The Riemann Hypothesis is widely regarded as a major unsolved problem in the mathematical field, dealing with the distribution of the zeros of the Riemann zeta function.

Further details regarding the peer review status or the specific methodology used during the process were not provided in the initial announcement.
